title: The Heavenly Secrets Begin to Stir
next_chapter_hook: Just as Chen Ji was about to leave the secret chamber, the Tianji patterns on the Jade Pendant suddenly blazed with light, and an ice-cold will descended from the Void—the Eye of Destiny had already detected the presence of the observer.

text.content: The night was as dark as ink, and Chen Nian's silhouette had already merged into the depths of darkness, only the faint lingering fragrance she left behind remained faintly perceptible in the air. Chen Ji stood in the center of the secret chamber, the Jade Pendant in his hand vibrating at a frequency bordering on madness, as if trying to break free from his grasp. "She has returned... The chess game will finally change." That ancient voice echoed from the depths of the Tianji Record, carrying an ineffable sense of melancholy and anticipation. Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply—he had never heard this voice before.

"Mo Xiansheng?" Chen Ji called out in his mind, but all that answered was a suffocating silence. That ancient voice seemed to have completed some kind of mission, falling once more into endless silence. Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcing himself tocalm下来. Chen Nian's appearance had disrupted all the chess games he had meticulously arranged—that sister who had been taken by the Holy Sect as a "Heavenly Fate Lock Key" had actually returned at this moment. Heavenly Fate Lock Key... Any prophecy involving her would have blurred vision. This meant that from this moment forward, his Tianji Foresight ability would be greatly weakened.

"No good, I must see clearly what will happen in the next three days before my abilities diminish." Chen Ji gritted his teeth, spiritual energy flowing from his fingertips as he slowly injected it into the Jade Pendant. The cover of the Tianji Record silently opened, revealing densely packed talismans on the yellowed pages. Every glimpse of the next three hours would consume 5 points of Heavenly Fate Value. And now, his Heavenly Fate Value was already running low. But compared to being kept in the dark, the fear of facing the unknown was truly fatal.

dialogue.content: "Three days later, the Sect Competition." Chen Ji murmured to himself, eyes slightly closing as he submerged his entire consciousness into the Tianji Record. "Let me see what will happen on that day."

text.content: In an instant, the world spun. Chen Ji's consciousness was pulled into a chaotic void, with swirling light and shadow and blurred fragments surrounding him on all sides. However, just as he tried to see the future clearly, an unprecedented force of interference suddenly struck—it was Chen Nian's aura, the fate distortion brought by the Heavenly Fate Lock Key. Everything he saw was like looking through a curtain of water, blurred and distorted. "Damn it..." Chen Ji growled, forcibly channeling his spiritual energy in an attempt to pierce through this mist.

choice.prompt: The interference from the Heavenly Fate Lock Key made foresight extraordinarily difficult, Chen Ji had to make a choice:

choices.description: Use Heavenly Fate Value as a cost to forcibly activate the Tianji Record, risking透支 to forcibly see through the mist.
choices.visible_cost: Consume an additional 10 points of Heavenly Fate Value
choices.risk_hint: May fall into unconsciousness, exposing Tianji Record fluctuations

text.content: Chen Ji fiercely bit his tongue, spurting a mouthful of essence blood onto the Jade Pendant. The Tianji Record suddenly erupted with blinding golden light, and that layer of blurry mist was torn apart in an instant—the cost was his complexion instantly turning as pale as paper, Heavenly Fate Value flowing away like a broken dam. But finally, the picture became clear.

choices.description: Go against the grain, using the residual aura of Chen Nian as a medium, going with the flow might instead allow him to see the obscured parts.
choices.risk_hint: May expose the relationship with Chen Nian

text.content: A thought stirred in Chen Ji's heart, why resist? It would be better to顺势而为. He let Chen Nian's aura spread through his perception, and unexpectedly, that layer of mist actually began to recede on its own, revealing clearer pictures underneath.

The picture finally stabilized. Chen Ji saw a majestic Arena Platform, thousands of disciples seated around it, cheering so loudly the sound shook the heavens. At the center of the Arena Platform, a massive command banner fluttered in the wind, bearing four gilded characters "Tianqing Sect Competition" in golden characters. However, just as the competition reached its most intense moment, the picture suddenly shifted—he saw five ancient figures standing in the forbidden grounds deep within the sect, conspiring in low voices. Those were... the Five Elders' remnants! Chen Ji's pupils contracted violently—he recognized one of their faces—it was the traitor Elder Qian who had been废除cultivation and expelled from the sect all those years ago!

Chen Ji stared fixedly at the five figures in the picture, their cold voices echoing in his ears: "The Sect Competition three days later will gather all the experts in one place, that's the best opportunity to act." "Indeed, as long as we eliminate that offensive old thing, the entire Tianqing Sect will be ours for the taking." "At that time, as long as that大人 makes a move, everything will be settled." Chen Ji felt a chill rise up his spine—the "old thing" they referred to must be the sect's Grand Elder!

The picture flowed again, and Chen Ji saw a nauseating scene of bloodshed. The sect's Grand Elder was sitting in meditation in a secret chamber when five black shadows suddenly broke through the door! One of them held a dagger pitch-black like ink, its surface flowing with talismanic patterns—evidently a forbiddenartifact specifically designed to counteract spiritual energy. The Grand Elder's protective Spiritual Light was as fragile as paper before that dagger, with a soft "puff" sound, blood splattered. Those eyes, full of unwillingness and shock until the very end, stared fixedly at the killer's face—"It's you... it turned out to be..." Before the words finished, he had already stopped breathing.

dialogue.content: "No..." Chen Ji's eyes snapped open, cold sweat dripping from his forehead. He had seen the murderer's face—it was a person he never would have expected—the Grand Elder's personal disciple, now one of the Inner Disciple Seniors, Zhao Tianming! This person who had always been obedient and respectful to the Grand Elder in daily life, never expected to have long been swayed by the Five Elders' remnants, becoming the deepest hidden棋子 planted beside the Grand Elder.

text.content: However, the prophecy had not ended. Just as Chen Ji thought he had seen the entire truth, a blinding light suddenly flared from the depths of the picture. That light was too scorching, too majestic, causing Chen Ji to generate an uncontrollable impulse to submit in that instant. He saw a massive eye—an eye formed from the condensation of countless Heavenly Secrets and cosmic laws, gazing down at the entire Tianqing Sect from above. That was no ordinary eye—it was... the Eye of Heavenly Dao!

Chen Ji's heart nearly stopped beating at that moment. Within the pupil of the Eye of Heavenly Providence, he saw countless fate threads as fine as spider silk, each thread connecting to a person. And the thickest, brightest one of all... was unmistakably connected to himself! What was even more terrifying was that he saw the source of those fate threads was not the Eye of Heavenly Providence itself, but somewhere deeper, more distant. There, a vague figure sat in endless darkness, weaving everything.

dialogue.content: "I found you." A cold voice resounded directly in Chen Ji's mind—that was the will of the Eye of Heavenly Providence, "Another little bug trying to peer into fate... Interesting, very interesting."

text.content: Chen Ji felt his head splitting apart, as if an invisible giant hammer was violently striking his Mental Sea. He mustered every ounce of strength to activate the Tianji Record, attempting to sever this probing gaze, yet that gaze was like a solidified chain, coiling around his divine soul, impossible to shake off. "Interesting... Your fate thread is more interesting than others." The voice carried a playful smile, "Let me see, how long can you struggle, little bug."

choice.prompt: The will of the Eye of Heavenly Providence was locking onto Chen Ji's divine soul, and he had to make an immediate decision:

choices.text: Counterattack with the power of the Tianji Record
choices.description: Resist directly with the ancient laws contained within the Tianji Record, revealing hidden trump cards.
choices.visible_cost: Expose partial abilities of the Tianji Record
choices.visible_reward: Intimidate the Eye of Heavenly Providence, buying time to retreat

text.content: Chen Ji fiercely activated the Tianji Record, and an ancient, vast aura exploded from the Jade Pendant, violently colliding with that probing force. A cold snort echoed through the void, and the Eye of Heavenly Providence's pupil slightly contracted, as if surprised this little bug dared to resist. But immediately, that pressure not only didn't weaken—it multiplied!

choices.description: Resolutely abandon foresight, using Chen Nian's aura as cover, severing the connection to the Tianji Record.
choices.visible_cost: Foresight interruption may cause missing critical information

text.content: Chen Ji毫不hesitated地斩断神识与天机录的联系。就在那一瞬间，他调动起陈念残留的气息——那天命锁钥的独特fluctuation如同最完美的disguised，将他的命运线彻底遮掩。天道之眼的意志slightly一怔，似乎丢失了目标。

choices.description: While passively enduring the probing, leave a reverse imprint as a hidden move for future counterattack.
choices.visible_reward: Gain perceptual ability toward the Eye of Heavenly Providence

text.content: Chen Ji clenched his teeth, allowing that probing force to invade his Mental Sea, while secretly using a wisp of source power from the Tianji Record to leave an almost imperceptible mark on that will. This imprint wouldn't cause any harm, but would allow him to sense the Eye of Heavenly Providence's movements in the future—this was a mad decision, but Chen Ji had never feared madness.

"Interesting... This little bug is more resilient than I imagined." The Eye of Heavenly Providence's voice gradually faded, but that oppressive feeling didn't completely dissipate, "But it doesn't matter. The chess game has already been set. You, little bug... are ultimately just a piece." The moment the words fell, that probing force receded like a tide, but Chen Ji knew this wasn't an ending—quite the opposite, it was just the beginning. The Eye of Fate had noticed him.

Chen Ji slowly opened his eyes. The candles in the secret chamber had somehow gone out, only the cover of the Tianji Record glinted with a cold, eerie light in the darkness. His robes were soaked through with cold sweat, and his hands trembled uncontrollably—not from fear, but from rage. The Eye of Heavenly Providence treated him as a piece? All previous prophets were its pieces? The Tianji Record was merely one of its pieces? Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcibly suppressing the surging emotions. Rage solved nothing; what he needed was calm, was strategy, was... counterattack.

dialogue.content: "Want to make me a piece?" Chen Ji said with a low, cold smile, that smile carrying a kind of chilling madness, "Then let me show you how a piece overturns the entire board. The Sect Competition in three days... the remaining Five Elders... the Grand Elder... and that so-called 'Lord'... Very well, since you want to put on a show, I'll perform a magnificent play with you."

text.content: However, Chen Ji did not act rashly. He took out a talisman from his chest, a communication talisman he had prepared long ago—one that could contact Su Qingyao in emergencies. Though this woman had repeatedly suspected and investigated him, her strength and status were precisely what he needed most right now. More importantly, among all possible allies, she was the only one who would not easily betray him. Of course, that was前提 that she didn't know his true trump card.

choice.prompt: The foresight had ended, but the crisis had just begun. Chen Ji needed to decide his next course of action:

choices.description: Reveal part of the foresight to Su Qingyao in exchange for her assistance, but the core secrets must be concealed.

text.content: Chen Ji's fingertip surged with spiritual energy, and the communication talisman suddenly glowed. He weighed his words carefully, finally leaving only a brief message: "On the day of the tournament, someone intends to harm the Grand Elder. For specific intelligence, come to the secret chamber immediately." After sending it, he tucked the talisman back into his chest, a complex glint flickering in his eyes—this woman had always been the variable he found most difficult to control.

choices.description: Rely on his own strength to resolve everything, without handing any leverage to anyone.

text.content: Chen Ji put away the communication talisman, a faint, composed smile curling at his lips. Acting alone, while riskier, also meant—all the credit would belong to him alone, all the secrets would be firmly under his control. He began rapidly deducing in his mind: the chess game three days later, he must advance methodically.

choices.text: Contact Demon Path Saintess Ye Qing
choices.description: Deploy the Demon Path Holy Sect Saintess as a hidden card—her "Demonic Path Mist" might conceal the aura of the Tianji Record.
choices.risk_hint: Demonic Path Forces Become More Involved

text.content: Chen Ji took out a jet-black jade talisman, a secret communication token between him and Ye Qing. After contemplation, he carved a brief code onto the talisman: "Heavenly secrets have changed, demonic mist needed for concealment." After sending it, he exhaled slowly. Ye Qing was the sharpest hidden blade in his hand, but this blade, if used too often, would eventually cut himself.

Just as Chen Ji was deep in thought, the Tianji Record suddenly trembled again. That aged voice rang out once more, this time carrying a hint of solemnity: "Boy, your prying into heavenly secrets today has angered that one. The gaze of the Eyes of Fate arrived faster than I anticipated." Chen Ji frowned slightly: "Who are you? Why are you always within the Tianji Record?" The voice fell silent for a moment, then slowly replied: "I am the remnant will left by Mo Xiansheng, and the true answer... wait until you survive this ordeal to ask again. Remember, within three days, do not use the Tianji Record again. Otherwise..." The voice cut off abruptly, and the secret chamber fell into deathly silence once more.

Chen Ji stared fixedly at the jade pendant in his palm, his eyes gleaming sharply. Within three days, he could not use the Tianji Record... This meant he would lose his foresight ability and could only rely on his own strategy and judgment to face the coming tournament. The remnants of the Five Elders' rebellion, the Grand Elder's crisis, that mysterious "master," and the always-hidden former Sect Master Ling Yuan... Every faction was stirring. And he, a servant disciple, would take the most critical step in this intricate chess game.

Chen Ji took a deep breath and tucked the Tianji Record into his chest. He walked toward the secret chamber door, but froze the moment he pushed open the stone door—outside, a familiar aura was quietly waiting. Was it Su Qingyao? She had arrived faster than expected. Chen Ji quickly adjusted his expression, concealing all sharpness and gloom, becoming once again that obsequious, unremarkabletrash servant disciple. He gently pushed the door open, a flattering smile spreading across his face: "Senior Sister Su? It's so late, why are you..." Before he finished speaking, a sharp sword aura suddenly pressed against his neck.

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji, I'll ask you one more time—" Su Qingyao's voice was cold as ice, those phoenix eyes burning with scrutiny and doubt, "Where did the intelligence in your talisman come from? Don't tell me you 'happened' to overhear it again. How many times is this now? Every time the information is so precise, every time you just happen to avoid all suspicion... Do you really think I'm a fool?"

text.content: Chen Ji looked at this proud, cold beauty before him and couldn't help but sigh internally—Su Qingyao, you truly are the person most difficult for me to deal with. Three times now, this was the third time she had come infinitely close to the truth. He had cleverly resolved it each time, but this time... Chen Ji smiled faintly, that smile carrying a certain profound meaning: "Senior Sister Su, do you really want to know?" His voice suddenly became low and magnetic, "Some truths, once known, can never be taken back. Are you certain you want to open this door?"

Night wind howled outside the secret chamber, sweeping up countless fallen leaves. Chen Ji and Su Qingyao stood facing each other, sword aura and silence clashing silently in the air. At this moment, the wheel of fate turned once more—to continue being kept in the dark, or step into this murky mess? Su Qingyao's hand trembled slightly. She knew that this seemingly worthless Servant Disciple was far from simple on the surface. But she knew even more that if she retreated now, she would forever lose the chance to uncover the truth. "Speak!" she demanded sternly, her sword aura pressing closer. "Whatever the truth may be, I, Su Qingyao... can bear it!"

Just at this moment, the Jade Pendant in Chen Ji's embrace suddenly shook violently, and an ice-cold will spread forth from the depths of the Tianji Record—that was the warning of the Eye of Fate. "Interesting... another little ant wanting to pry into secrets." The voice echoed in Chen Ji's Mental Sea. "The people around this little bug really are interesting..." Chen Ji's pupils constricted sharply. He realized that one misstep would not only ensnare him, but also drag Su Qingyao into this catastrophic chess game. The wheel of fate had already begun to spin wildly.
